\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 186-188 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R191-first-pass-words-from-chapters-186-188}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a workshop and a signature.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a hobby, chess, a novel, a painting; a board, a machine
  \item a blender, a tap, a pipe, a wire, a rope
  \item a currency, a bill, a discount, a customer, a cashier; a money changer
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A hobby? (\textbf{\ar{هواية}}, \emph{hiwāya}.) Chess? (\textbf{\ar{شطرنج}}, \emph{shiṭranj}.) A novel? (\textbf{\ar{رواية}}, \emph{riwāya}.) A painting; a board? (\textbf{\ar{لوحة}}, \emph{lawḥa}.) A machine? (\textbf{\ar{آلة}}, \emph{āla}.) A blender? (\textbf{\ar{خلاط}}, \emph{khallāṭ}.) A tap? (\textbf{\ar{صنبور}}, \emph{ṣunbūr}.) A pipe? (\textbf{\ar{أنبوب}}, \emph{unbūb}.) A wire? (\textbf{\ar{سلك}}, \emph{silk}.) A rope? (\textbf{\ar{حبل}}, \emph{ḥabl}.) A currency? (\textbf{\ar{عملة}}, \emph{ʿumla}.) A bill? (\textbf{\ar{فاتورة}}, \emph{fātūra}.) A discount? (\textbf{\ar{خصم}}, \emph{khaṣm}.) A customer? (\textbf{\ar{زبون}}, \emph{zabūn}.) A cashier; a money changer? (\textbf{\ar{صراف}}, \emph{ṣarrāf}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

An accountant? (\textbf{\ar{محاسب}}, \emph{muḥāsib}.) A journalist? (\textbf{\ar{صحفي}}, \emph{ṣuḥufī}.) A worker? (\textbf{\ar{عامل}}, \emph{ʿāmil}.) A translator? (\textbf{\ar{مترجم}}, \emph{mutarjim}.) An interview? (\textbf{\ar{مقابلة}}, \emph{muqābala}.) A singer? (\textbf{\ar{مغني}}, \emph{mughannī}.) A player? (\textbf{\ar{لاعب}}, \emph{lāʿib}.) A coach? (\textbf{\ar{مدرب}}, \emph{mudarrib}.) Mathematics? (\textbf{\ar{رياضيات}}, \emph{riyāḍiyyāt}.) Geography? (\textbf{\ar{جغرافيا}}, \emph{jughrāfiyā}.) A plumber? (\textbf{\ar{سباك}}, \emph{sabbāk}.) A grocer? (\textbf{\ar{بقال}}, \emph{baqqāl}.) A fisherman? (\textbf{\ar{صياد}}, \emph{ṣayyād}.) A workshop? (\textbf{\ar{ورشة}}, \emph{warsha}.) A signature? (\textbf{\ar{توقيع}}, \emph{tawqīʿ}.)
